Overview

Innovate. Build. Disrupt. 24 Hours at SIMATS.

HACK.2027 is the flagship National-Level 24-Hour Hybrid Hackathon hosted by SIMATS Engineering (Saveetha School of Engineering), Chennai. Designed to bring together 1,000+ student innovators, developers, and problem-solvers from across India, HACK.2027 challenges builders to turn bold ideas into working, real-world prototypes.

Whether you are passionate about software engineering, artificial intelligence, hardware & smart systems, or interdisciplinary engineering, HACK.2027 offers a high-energy environment to collaborate, build under pressure, and showcase your technical creativity in front of industry leaders and academic experts.

Event Dates & Venue

  • Finale Dates: February 18–19, 2027 (24-Hour Offline Hackathon)
  • Venue: SIMATS Engineering (Saveetha School of Engineering), Chennai, Tamil Nadu

Hackathon Format

Round 1: Online Idea & PPT Screening (Late January 2027)

Teams register on Devfolio and submit their project proposal / presentation (PPT) outlining the problem statement, proposed architecture, innovation, and feasibility. Submissions are evaluated on originality, technical depth, and real-world impact to shortlist the top 60 teams.

Round 2: 24-Hour Offline Finale on Campus (February 18–19, 2027)

Shortlisted finalist teams travel to the SIMATS Engineering campus in Chennai for an intense, non-stop 24-hour live build. Teams will prototype from scratch and pitch their working solutions to an jury panel for top honors and prizes.

Mandatory Registration Steps for HACK.2027

  • Join our WhatsApp Community: Hop into our official WhatsApp group (https://chat.whatsapp.com/C0jcG6eJ9kx1afpPby0YbJ) so you don't miss Round 1 deadlines, announcements, and finale shortlists for Feb 18–19, 2027 at SIMATS Engineering, Chennai!

Why Participate?

  • Compete alongside top student builders from across the country.
  • Receive hands-on mentorship and feedback from industry practitioners and researchers.
  • Build a functional prototype in 24 hours and showcase it live to an expert jury.
  • Win exciting cash prizes, awards, and recognition.
